purpose: Preregistered limited comparison before any candidate P&L is computed

continuous_validation_window.name: validation_combined
continuous_validation_window.purpose: One uninterrupted wallet per comparison, plus actual one-wallet five-leg portfolio; no September reset

extended_backcast.purpose: Frozen finalist robustness only; TRX lacks these local dates; no reselection

contamination: October 2026 was explicitly examined in earlier range-sweep, RSI and other discovery. Earlier dates also occur in prior saved-result/research history; no genuinely untouched historical holdout is claimed. Validation is chronological and held out from this run's parameter selection only.

selection.frequency_target: At least 2 completed trades per calendar day PER COIN, not pooled across coins
selection.eligibility: Every coin in both selection windows at 5bps: net>0, PF>=1.20, DD<=12%, completed trades/day>=2
selection.ranking: Lexicographic descending: all ten coin/window cases eligible; number of eligible cases; minimum net return across the ten 5bps cases; total 5bps net P&L. Candidate ID breaks exact ties ascending.
selection.freeze: Write frozen_selection.json and its hash before starting any validation computation. No parameter changes, coin exclusions or fallback reselection after validation. If none eligible, still test the highest-ranked candidate as a diagnostic finalist, never call it qualified.

preset_gate.independent_accounts: Each coin in BOTH validation months at BOTH slippages: net>0, PF>=1.20, DD<=12%, trades/day>=2
preset_gate.shared_wallet: One actual production portfolio, INR50000 total, fixed symbol order as listed; BOTH validation months at BOTH costs positive with PF>=1.20, DD<=12%; report per-coin frequency, require >=2/day per coin
preset_gate.concentration: At 5bps validation: no single coin >50% of positive-net coin contribution; no month >75% of positive monthly contribution; net still positive after subtracting five largest winning trade P&Ls (fixed-ledger sensitivity, not a counterfactual resimulation)
preset_gate.holdout: No strict untouched historical holdout available. Even a historical pass requires explicit caveat and prospective paper observation; no automatic deployment.
preset_gate.action: If any gate fails: print No qualifying strategy and do NOT change Research Lab presets or deployed profiles.

range_sweep_5m_October.source: user-reported baseline, not independently reproduced because full original request absent

baseline.RSI_snapback: user reports loss; exact metrics/configuration unavailable

robustness: Report per-coin/per-month contributions, top-five winning-trade dependency, long/short totals, funding, costs, 2->5bps degradation, and separate INR250000 sum-of-independent-accounts from the INR50000 shared wallet. October never selects or qualifies the strategy.
